## Results

Speed and stopping distance are correlated (@fig-cars). The residuals show no
trend (@suppfig-resid), and neither do the fitted values (@suppfig-fitted).
@tbl-coef gives the model coefficients and @tbl-data the first rows of the data.

```{r}
#| label: fig-cars
#| fig-cap: Stopping distance against speed.
plot(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
```

:::{#suppfig-resid}

```{r}
fit <- lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
plot(fit$fitted.values, resid(fit))
```

Residuals against fitted values.

:::

```{r}
#| label: tbl-coef
#| tbl-cap: Model coefficients.
knitr::kable(coef(summary(fit)), digits = 2)
```

:::{#suppfig-fitted}

```{r}
plot(cars$speed, fit$fitted.values)
```

Fitted values against speed.

:::

::: landscape

```{r}
#| label: tbl-data
#| tbl-cap: First rows of the data.
knitr::kable(head(cars))
```

:::
